drivers: Three independent attribute rules (shape, fill, rotation) must all be resolved; Latin-square distribution of shape and fill is a familiar pattern
Rotation follows a +45° progression within rows, requiring careful angle discrimination (180° vs 270°) among distractors
Distractors each differ from the key on only one attribute, so partial rule discovery yields wrong answers
90 seconds is adequate but visually dense cells (4 rotated figures each) add perceptual load
